description: Get full details for one assignment: instructions, due/lock dates, points, submission types and the rubric. Read-only. Prompt text written by the instructor is fenced as untrusted. Get assignment_id from list_assignments.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.
